text:
alisha: Quick follow-up from the 3/11 postmortem — consolidating action items for testing/evals. TL;DR: need owners for regression sweep (kv/eviction), prompt-set expansion, load test scenario for 95th pct traffic, and a chaos drill for node preemption. I'll propose owners and timelines below — please confirm or reassign.

ben: I'm happy to own the regression sweep (kv/eviction). Can we scope a small signal first? target: run in sandbox, then prod-canary. Timeline: spike this week, run tests next Tue. @alisha assign me?

chris: I can pick up prompt-set expansion for the top 5 failing prompts. Need help getting the failing list from evals. @eva who owns eval exports?

eva: I own exports — will drop a link to the CSV in the doc. Also we should add a prompt-level label to track flaky vs drift. :thinking_face:

alisha: Link to tracking doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/postmortem-174... (see doc) — owners + dates below. Ben: regression sweep — spike by 2025-03-18, run sandbox 2025-03-20, prod-canary 2025-03-25. Chris: prompt-sets — gather failures by 2025-03-17, new prompts vetted by 2025-03-22. Dave: load test scenario — can you lead?

dave: Yep — I'll take load tests. Plan: reproduce outage pattern at +10% QPS bump + heavy prompt set. Build harness by 2025-03-19, run full load 2025-03-23. Will need GPUs from dedicated pool; @infra please approve.

infra-bot: Request received: dedicated-GPU pool allocation for load-test-173456. ETA 1 business day.

ben: For the regression sweep I'll add tests to CI under `ci/regression/kv_eviction/*`. Quick command to run locally: `pytest tests/regression/test_kv_eviction.py::TestEviction -k "smoke" -q`

chris: When we run prompt expansions, can we add those to the recurring eval cron? I don't want to lose coverage. Suggest weekly job pushed to the evals cron.

alisha: Agree — make prompt-set addition a recurring eval. Owner: Chris. Recurrence: weekly (every Tue). I'll add Jira tickets and link back. Jira board: https://jira.redwood/browse/INFRA-PT

eva: CSV export link: https://storage.internal/evals/pm-174/failures.csv — will annotate flaky flags.

dave: Chaos drill idea: simulate single-AZ GPU preemption during high KV tail latencies. Who's oncall that week? We should coordinate with oncall rotation and do a dry-run in staging first.

alisha: Oncall for week of 2025-03-24 is @sara. Plan: dry-run 2025-03-21 staging, chaos drill 2025-03-26 prod-canary. Sara pls confirm.

sara: I can take the dry-run and the canary window. +1 to dry-run first. I'll block time on calendar.

alisha: Great — I'll update the tracking doc and the postmortem action list. Assignments: Ben (regression sweep), Chris (prompt sets + weekly eval), Dave (load tests + chaos scenario), Eva (eval exports), Sara (oncall coordination). If you need to reassign, comment here by EOD. :thumbsup:
